body:
## What this changes

Retires the old plan-approval gate, as the first piece (PR D) of the orchestrator build for issue 655. Nothing runs this code: the issue watcher has `enabled: false` and never ran live. Removing it first also means PR A can delete the `issue_watch` symbols the old package imported without a shim.

- Deletes `src/superclaude/cli/issue_pipeline/` (the `issue-pipeline` command group), its registration in `cli/main.py`, `tests/issue_pipeline/` and `tests/cli/test_issue_pipeline_registered.py`. `issue_watch` is untouched.
- `WORKER-CONTRACT.md`: removes rule WC-17 and the "Issue pipeline duties" section. The one sentence guard rule 2 depends on (a worker's `ask` and `send` carry no `--to`) is kept as its own bullet in the worker-session duties, and `tests/skills/test_worker_contract.py` asserts it there (finding F14 of issue 665).
- `launch-level-guard.sh` (source and plugin copy, byte-identical): removes the first G2 rule only, the `case` that classed `release-worker` and the `issue-pipeline` verbs as TAMPER. Rule 2 (a bound worker may run `orchestration send` and `ask` only as one plain call with no `--to`) and the guard's own `sessions/<sid>.ok` approval path are untouched.
- `tests/hooks/test_launch_level_guard_worker.py` no longer imports the deleted package. The release in the chain test is now a typed `/sc:implement` prompt, the nonce-binding test builds its prompt from the existing `_marker` helper, and the verb TAMPER cases and the plan-hash test are deleted. Every other rule 2 test is kept (107 pass).
- Docs: one sentence in `SUPERVISED-ORCHESTRATION-TECHNICAL-REFERENCE.md` that described the removed coordinator hand-off, and the `issue-pipeline` rows in `docs/user-guide/cli-groups.md` (see Deviations). One line under `[Unreleased]` in `CHANGELOG.md`.

Refs IronbellyOrg/IronClaude#655

## Independent review of the guard change

A fresh reader who did not write the change reviewed commit `699bf3a5d` against the live guard: both copies byte-identical (`cmp` and sha256), G2 rule 2 untouched (`--to`, `--run`, `--environment` and `--pairing-code` still refused), the `.ok` approval path untouched, the store-path TAMPER rule that blocks a forged `.ok` intact, and the rewritten tests keep the bound-chain and nonce-binding coverage. Result: **PASS**, no blocking defect. Three form-only notes: the comment says "rule 1" although the design note has no numbered rules (the spec's own table uses that name), the design note `issue-pipeline-guard-g2.md` still describes the coordinator-side release helper (it keeps its history), and the gitignored `.claude/` dev copy needs `make sync-dev`.

## Generator-Constraint Considered

This pull request adds no gate, validator or structural checker. It only deletes a TAMPER pattern list from the launch-level guard, which matched commands that no longer exist, and the package those commands belonged to. There is no producer-side constraint to weigh. The guard is a security control, so the change had the independent review above; nothing else in the guard changed.

## Tests

- Task checks: `uv run superclaude --help` lists `issue-watch` and not `issue-pipeline`; `issue-watch --help` runs; `grep -rn -e issue_pipeline -e issue-pipeline src tests | grep -v -e issue-pipeline-fu1 -e issue-pipeline-guard-g2` prints nothing; `cmp` of the two guard copies prints nothing.
- Full suite with `-n 4`: 22893 passed, 69 skipped, 2 failed. The two failures were `test_install_hooks.py::test_launch_identity_real_install_preserves_policies_and_is_idempotent` timing out while the build box was out of memory; both pass alone in under a second. The serial `test_verify_sync_hooks.py` (7), `tests/swarm -m imm` (84) and `-m inv` (107) pass.
- `make lint`, `ruff format --check src/ tests/`, `make verify-deps` (in a separate lock-resolved environment, as CI does), `make sync-dev` and `make verify-sync`, `git diff --check`, and a throwaway-HOME `superclaude install` and `doctor --verbose` all pass.

## Deviations

- `docs/user-guide/cli-groups.md` documented the removed `issue-pipeline` group and is not in the PR D file list. I removed its rows and heading so the user guide does not describe a command that is gone.
- The nonce-binding test is renamed (`..._a_prompt_with_a_pending_nonce_...`) because it no longer builds a brief.
- The four files PR D greps: only the technical reference needed an edit. `orchestrator-mode.md`, the issue-331 deviation-patterns file and `yaml-deviation-class.yaml` have no hit and are unchanged. The `check-config` line in the technical reference that names the approvers file keeps its hit: `issue_watch` is unchanged here and PR A removes that check.
- The status banners of the six older design docs are PR E's and are not added here.
title: refactor: retire the old plan-approval gate (issue 655, PR D)
